Includes options, behavior trees, residual control, DAgger, CompILE, SPiRL, VIPER, PROPEL, DreamCoder, PDDLStream, OR-Tools, LLM-GS, SymSkill and Evolving Programmatic Skill Networks.

local_static_audit.method: Decode current Shop raw actions through the installed kaggriculture_bonsai package; count literal route, lane, phase and motif structure; no simulation.
local_static_audit.warning: Requested actions are not realized production. Stored route prefixes are not the actual controller's legal routing schedule.

optional_ignored_corroboration.limit: Ignored export may be unavailable in a clean checkout. Committed productivity.json independently establishes the failure; this export is not required, copied, or promoted into a dataset.

limitations: No chosen representation is implemented or empirically validated by this research.
No current leaderboard ranking or substantive official deadline obtained from the inspected responses.
No new full replay decoding or live public-agent benchmark.
The supplied representative Shop realized-production vector was not independently reproduced; hire requests were verified.
All new representation effort, resource and throughput numbers are estimates with explicit stop conditions, not measurements.
